charts.title: Will this NIM fit a 128 GB Spark? (NVFP4, ×1.18 overhead)
charts.caption: lab03_spark_fit_check.py: params_B × 0.55 GB/B (NVFP4) × 1.18 overhead vs the ~115 GB usable budget. Super fits only at Q4/NVFP4; Ultra (≈357 GB) fits nowhere on Sparks — cloud-only. Run the fit math before a 50 GB pull.

charts.caption: lab02_base_url_swap.py expected-output samples (illustrative — your numbers will differ): the cloud call adds network RTT + gateway queueing. The point is the code diff between the two calls: 0 lines.

charts.caption: Same lab02 expected-output samples (illustrative): ~38 tok in 2.1 s locally vs ~41 tok in 3.4 s hosted. Identical client code measured both — the swap drill is the entire migration cost.
